text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho is here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature steps onto the racecourse focused on her goal…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To win the race and become a top-class runner both in name and reality.
